text: a wave taller than anything in this city.
A normal wave: about two meters.
As tall as a house: ten meters.
The tsunami in Japan, in 2011, surged up to about forty meters.
This office tower: three hundred meters.
But in 1958, in Lituya Bay, Alaska, a landslide crashed into the water.
The water raced up the mountain…
Is anything in your city that tall?
